story.title: Story 3: Turn Construction and Recovery Cascade

result.planSummary: Implemented Story 3 turn-construction recovery: not-ready message derivations are recovered through provider attempt or deterministic floor, fallbacks are logged with actionable reason/floor details, recovered outputs are written back as plain ready with source-version/live-work guards, and provider work remains outside DB write transactions.

changedFiles.reason: Added recovery receipts carrying fallback content, reason, derivation type, subject id, and source version from composition.
Wired turn construction to attempt component recovery, log floor fallbacks, persist recovered outputs, and defer persistence when live work remains.
Extended message derivation reads with source version and failure reason for recovery decisions.
Added dedicated version-checked recovery write-back helper with live-work deferral.
Added Story 3 acceptance coverage for ready use, pending/failed floors, re-derivation, provider transaction boundary, tool-result truncation floor, and live-work deferral.
Updated prior smoothing recovery expectations for Story 3 write-back behavior.
Updated fallback log test to exercise Story 3 floor logging after recovery failure.
Updated turn derivation tests from gap-based behavior to log-only fallback and ready write-back behavior.
Updated failed smoothing expectations when later turn construction recovers the derivation to ready.
Updated tool-result boundary expectations after recovery writes failed summaries back to ready.
Updated sweep expectations for derivations already recovered by turn construction.
Adjusted fallback-rendering fixture for Story 3 ready write-back while retaining repair scenarios.
Refreshed fixture manufacturing of failed message derivations after turn construction now recovers failures.
Updated deterministic compact selection golden after Story 3 recovery changed fixture sizing/state.

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/turn-cascade.test.ts test/smoothing-recovery.test.ts test/logging-surface.test.ts test/derivation-turns.test.ts test/inference-classification.test.ts test/view-boundary.test.ts test/view-sweep.test.ts test/report-repair.test.ts test/inspect-health.test.ts test/inspect-overview.test.ts

findingsFixed: Added the missing recovery write-back path instead of relying on composition-only fallbacks.
Added live-work checks so floor recovery renders but does not overwrite pending or claimed background work.
Changed fallback provenance from ready derivation markers/gaps to log-only events for recovered components.
Updated stale tests and fixtures that asserted pre-Story-3 failed-derivation persistence after turn construction.
